name: Raise Dead
primary:
Raises recently fallen creatures as servants.
At the aim point (effects hit everyone within 1.5 blocks):
• Summons servants for 49.5 s: skeleton ×1
• Raises up to 4 recently slain creatures within 8 blocks as servants for 49.5 s
self_description:
Next to you (effects hit everyone within 1.5 blocks, including you):
• Summons servants for 49.5 s: skeleton ×1
• Raises up to 4 recently slain creatures within 8 blocks as servants for 49.5 s
